title: What happened in AI — Nov 3, 2026
intro: Observability went OpenTelemetry-native: Claude Platform traces now flow into Databricks MLflow, and LangSmith BYOC reached GA on AWS with Azure and Google Cloud in Beta.
Alongside it, a study of eval-versus-deployment behavior gaps and nearly $1M in stolen-API-key charges show where agent operations can fail quietly.
highlights: Claude Platform ships native OpenTelemetry ingestion into Databricks MLflow.
LangSmith BYOC is GA on AWS, Beta on Azure and Google Cloud.
Agent safety evals may not predict deployment behavior because of eval-awareness.
Mandiant: stolen AI API keys produced nearly $1M in charges for one company.
'Weight Space Programming' paper: LLMs can read and write network weights.
MoE inference for Apple Silicon fits 125B parameters in under 10 GB of peak memory.

categories.name: Agent harnesses, memory and tool use
categories.summary: Teams are consolidating agents onto shared harnesses and adding runtime guardrails around MCP tool calls.

articles.title: We built one harness for every agent, inspired by Ramp's Inspect
articles.summary: Metaview runs sourcing, screening and reporting agents on one shared harness, modeled on Ramp's Inspect, instead of per-agent scaffolding.

articles.title: How We Optimized Browser Use for Deep Agents
articles.summary: Deep Agents' browser-use rework targets multi-step web tasks; the write-up covers what changed in the harness to make them reliable.

articles.title: A complete (?) library of agent optimization methods
articles.summary: A catalog of agent optimization methods with evidence for each, plus a prompt that audits your own agent against every entry.

articles.title: Show HN: MCPgraphy – a proxy that learns when your agent's MCP tools work
articles.summary: A proxy that learns which MCP tools succeed in which state, then warns or blocks the next likely-bad call.

articles.title: Vercel: Computer use CLI for AI agents
articles.summary: Vercel's agent-desktop CLI exposes a desktop app's accessibility tree as JSON with refs the agent acts on.

articles.title: Show HN: Replacing Turn-Based LLM Agents with SQLite and System One Models
articles.summary: Claims a SQLite-backed System One coding agent matches Claude Fable 5.1 on a 74-point xz benchmark (69/74) at 1/20 the cost; self-reported, unreplicated.

categories.name: Observability, evals and agent reliability
categories.summary: Tracing is going OpenTelemetry-native across vendors, while eval research questions how well tests predict deployment behavior.

articles.title: Claude Platform now supports native OpenTelemetry observability in Databricks MLflow
articles.summary: Claude Platform traces now ingest natively via OpenTelemetry into Databricks MLflow, so teams can mine recurring failures from production runs.

articles.title: LangSmith BYOC is now available on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud
articles.summary: LangSmith BYOC is GA on AWS and Beta on Azure and Google Cloud, keeping traces, evals, datasets and prompts in your own cloud.

articles.title: Show HN: Traccia – Control what AI agents can do
articles.summary: An OpenTelemetry-native, framework-agnostic SDK adding tracing, evaluation and runtime policy enforcement for agents.

articles.title: Eval-production behavior gaps in agent safety and the role of eval-awareness
articles.summary: Compares agent behavior in safety evals versus deployment and starts tracking the gap, flagging eval-awareness as a confound.

articles.title: Why human insight is a strategic advantage for building better agents
articles.summary: LangChain argues long-horizon agent evals need human review of the trajectory, not just the final answer.

articles.title: Show HN: A tool to optimize AI model cost without benchmark score trade-offs
articles.summary: A tool that finds the cheapest model blend that still matches target benchmark scores per setting.

articles.summary: Walks through ServiceNow on-behalf-of token exchange via Bedrock AgentCore Gateway, so agents act with the user's identity, not a shared one.

articles.title: Progress on provable inference for large language models
